card.name: Deteriorating in acutely worsening patients
card.fires_on: The word 'deteriorating' (the piece 'deterior' or 'ating') after 'acutely' or 'rapidly' in warnings about asthma or COPD. It also fires on 'quence' in 'rapid-sequence'.
